description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named GlobalErrorController that handles global error scenarios such as 404 or 500 errors. It intercepts errors routed to /error and responds with a JSON payload including timestamp, status code, error message, request path, and optional error details.

classes.name: GlobalErrorController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller that captures all errors mapped to /error and returns a JSON response with error details, effectively overriding default error handling to provide custom JSON error responses.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles error requests to /error endpoint, constructs a JSON body with timestamp, status, error message, and request URI, then returns it with the appropriate HTTP status.
